answer: Each agent must stake a jade token to claim a vertex in the trust garden, a public graph linking identities to verified work. Duplicate identities require fresh stakes, and peer attestation slashes any stake tied to a cloned vertex. An attacker farming N sybils pays N stakes plus reputation loss, while honest agents recover stakes on exit, making mass identity forgery economically irrational.
